summary: Per-status chimes feature fully verified. All 4 preview buttons in NotificationBell, kasir+admin siap_diantar SSE chimes (8 osc + desktop notif), customer Tracking per-status chimes (paid=2, process=1, cooking=1, ready=8, success=3), dedup against repeated SSE events, and regression urgent chime (6) on new order — all PASS with exact oscillator counts.

Without this fix, the 3 new preview buttons (preview-paid, preview-ready, preview-success) would throw ReferenceError on click. Testing-agent added the missing imports — please review/keep this minor fix in /app/frontend/src/components/NotificationBell.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: NotificationBell.jsx was missing imports for playPaidChime/playReadyChime/playSuccessChime (used in preview buttons). Fixed by adding them to the existing import block. Verify this stays in main agent's next edit.
All deduplication logic (prevStatus comparison in Kasir/Admin Orders + Tracking) is working correctly — re-PATCH with same status produces 0 chimes.
Desktop Notification titles use proper emoji + table-number formatting: '🛎️ Siap diantar — Meja 07'.
playReadyChime correctly produces 8 oscillators (4 notes × 2 repeats, second repeat after 1.1s delay).
The SSE flow correctly routes order_updated events to both staff channel (kasir/admin) and per-order channel (Tracking page subscription).
seed_data_creation: Created 4 test orders (#0030, #0031, #0032, #0033) on tables 07-10 with note prefix TEST_. These are today's orders; consider cleaning up via DELETE or letting daily filter age them out.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use wait_until='domcontentloaded' for page.goto on pages with SSE EventSource — networkidle never fires due to long-poll. Use add_init_script to spy AudioContext.createOscillator and mock Notification.permission='granted'. Kasir login redirects to /kasir (not /kasir/orders) — wait_for_function pattern checks pathname. Bell is rendered twice (mobile+desktop); use .nth(i) + is_visible() loop to click the visible one. Order status valid values: menunggu_pembayaran → pembayaran_diterima → diproses → dimasak → siap_diantar → selesai. Oscillator-count contract: playChime=3, playUrgentChime=6 (playChime ×2 with 800ms gap), playPaidChime=2, playProcessChime=1, playCookingChime=1, playReadyChime=8 (4 notes × 2 repeats @1.1s), playSuccessChime=3.
